name: Nordic nRF9160 DK

source_references.title: Nordic nRF9160 DK external memory documentation

record_note: The board contains an on-board J-Link interface and an nRF52840 board controller. DK v0.14.0 and later adds 8 MiB external SPI flash, which is revision- and routing-dependent and is not the nRF9160 application flash. Clock configuration, exact fitted SiP revision, build profile, and flash profile remain open.

onboard_devices.name: SEGGER J-Link OB
onboard_devices.function: On-board debugger/programmer and virtual COM interface

onboard_devices.name: nRF52840 board controller
onboard_devices.function: Board-control MCU; controls routing of optional external flash to the nRF9160 SiP
onboard_devices.notes: DK version 0.14.0 and later includes 8 MiB external flash. The board revision and routing configuration must be selected before using it.
